pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'bien' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. hi, bye
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. well

2. What does 'la sœur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the brother
   B. the sister
   C. the baby
   D. the family

3. How do you say 'In the kitchen, there is a fridge.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma maison.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Mets le livre sur la table.
   D. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

4. What does 'la télé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the kitchen
   B. the sofa
   C. the TV
   D. the window

5. What does 'la chambre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cat
   B. the fridge
   C. the book
   D. the bedroom

6. What does 'mercredi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Wednesday

7. What does 'je danse' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. I dance
   C. I sing
   D. I rest

8. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. twelve
   B. ten
   C. nine
   D. eleven

9. What number is 'trente' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 30
   C. 10
   D. 3

10. What does 'un ballon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a balloon
   C. a month
   D. a candle

11. What does 'l'eau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. water
   C. health
   D. sweets

12. Fill in: Excusez-moi, où ______ l'école ? (1 mark)
   A. sont
   B. est
   C. ai
   D. fait

13. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How do you spell it?
   B. Yes, I am fine.
   C. My name is Njeri.
   D. Good evening, Madam!

14. What does 'Oui, ça va.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, I am fine.
   B. Goodbye, Sir.
   C. Good evening, Madam!
   D. Hi, Kamau!

15. What does 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. Good evening, Madam!
   C. What is your name?
   D. Hello, Amina!

16. Which little word goes with 'frère' (the brother)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

17. Which little word goes with 'chaise' (the chair)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

18. What does 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Monday, I go to school.
   B. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   C. On Thursday, I sing.
   D. Today it is Monday.

19. What does 'Je chante et je danse.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. I am nine years old.
   C. I sing and I dance.
   D. Thank you very much!

20. Which little word goes with 'riz' (the rice)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. le

21. Which little word goes with 'tête' (the head)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

22. Which little word goes with 'main' (the hand)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. les

23. What does 'Il fait froid.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is sunny.
   B. It is cold.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is hot.

24. How do you say 'yes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. oui
   C. bonsoir
   D. Madame

25. How do you say 'Here is' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la fille
   B. le garçon
   C. Qui est-ce ?
   D. Voici

26. Fill in: ______ sœur s'appelle Njeri. (1 mark)
   A. Un
   B. Ma
   C. Le
   D. Mon

27. How do you write the number 21 in French? (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. dix-huit
   C. six
   D. vingt et un

28. How do you write the number 14 in French? (1 mark)
   A. quatorze
   B. dix-huit
   C. vingt et un
   D. treize

29. How do you say 'the storm' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la pluie
   B. l'orage
   C. le vent
   D. le soleil

30. How do you say 'to the left' in French? (1 mark)
   A. près de
   B. à côté de
   C. tout droit
   D. à gauche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'Voici ma maison.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Explain how to search safely on the internet when you look for a text about the body. (4 marks) (4 marks)

33. Write the French words for: yesterday, the school, Friday (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'My name is Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Explain why accents are important in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'Elle est petite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Write and read aloud a short greeting for a card to a girl called Njeri. Write what you would say. (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Oui, ça va.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'She has black hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Elle est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'Demain, il fait beau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'I like milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'Touch your nose!' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'Happy birthday!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'C'est mon père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'On Friday, I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — well
   bien means well.

2. B — the sister
   la sœur means the sister.

3. D — Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   In the kitchen, there is a fridge. in French is Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

4. C — the TV
   la télé means the TV.

5. D — the bedroom
   la chambre means the bedroom.

6. D — Wednesday
   mercredi means Wednesday.

7. B — I dance
   je danse means I dance.

8. B — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

9. B — 30
   trente means 30.

10. B — a balloon
   un ballon means a balloon.

11. B — water
   l'eau means water.

12. B — est
   Où est ... ? asks where something is.

13. A — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?

14. A — Yes, I am fine.
   Oui, ça va. means Yes, I am fine.

15. C — What is your name?
   Comment tu t'appelles ? means What is your name?

16. B — le
   frère is masculine, so we say le frère.

17. C — la
   chaise is feminine, so we say la chaise.

18. A — On Monday, I go to school.
   Le lundi, je vais à l'école. means On Monday, I go to school.

19. C — I sing and I dance.
   Je chante et je danse. means I sing and I dance.

20. D — le
   riz is masculine, so we say le riz.

21. C — la
   tête is feminine, so we say la tête.

22. A — la
   main is feminine, so we say la main.

23. B — It is cold.
   Il fait froid. means It is cold.

24. B — oui
   yes in French is oui.

25. D — Voici
   Here is in French is Voici.

26. B — Ma
   Sœur is feminine, so we say ma.

27. D — vingt et un
   21 in French is vingt et un.

28. A — quatorze
   14 in French is quatorze.

29. B — l'orage
   the storm in French is l'orage.

30. D — à gauche
   to the left in French is à gauche.
